title: Lake Tahoe Chef-Led 4 Course Progressive Dinner Tour
includes: Stunning lake and mountain views at golden hour and into the evening.
Stories of Tahoe’s history, culture, and local landmarks.
Curated stops spanning Heavenly Village and the Stateline district.
Learn about a local bombing involving some of the most complex devices ever encountered by the FBI.
Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
There's a moment in Lake Tahoe when the sun drops behind the Sierra Nevada, the lake turns gold, and the village comes alive. This is the tour built for that moment.

This progressive dinner tour takes you through three handpicked local restaurants across Heavenly Village and the Stateline district pairing four indulgent courses with the stories that shape this corner of Lake Tahoe.

From island-inspired flavors, a dash of New Orleans soul and elevated comfort food to decadent desserts, every restaurant has been carefully selected to showcase the range and ambition of Tahoe's evolving food scene. 

Between courses, discover how Stateline became a Pony Express stop, how the Comstock Lode transformed the region, and the unbelievable story of the 1980 Harvey’s Casino bombing, one of the most complex IEDs encountered by the FBI.

This isn't just dinner. It's an evening of great food, local history, and the best possible way to spend an evening in Tahoe.

Come hungry and curious!
